rongmei.title: Reikhou Mousi rui Kanaan ram nzuan

lines: 1. Reikhou Mousi rui Kanaan ram nzuan,
Nduangh ngam mak Raguang lat tei phunga;
Kanaan ram gun daihmei le gaimei tei hou,
Lum mah ninga kapni maknga cho?
He! Ai rui Kanaan ram gaimei tei,
Apumtan rui guang tang ngam mak;
Rei khou Guangh Zehovah zan rui zailou,
Kanaan ram gaimei guai tei hopu puni.
2. Kanaan rim tei tingthan pat kum e,
Zailou Mousi rui guang khang nduanga;
Jordan duipaeng than tei bamlou du maknga,
Nzianmei nunta zai patlou the.
3. Lungning gaimei ram ta tei ning lana,
Guangh ram gaimei tingsaenga gaipui ram;
Khou tei guangpui kan khou ram gaimei lung khou,
Kapumma mun kum guang puanglou ni.
4. Kanaan munpuang le nambam gaimei khou,
Zailou Mousi rui thei’ nganna lungh khang;
Lumloumei nun Salem ‘than ta thuanku the,
Israel nunni lumlou dat the.
